# Stockfish

`stockfish-17.1-lite-single-03e3232.js` and `.wasm` are Stockfish.js 17.1 (lite, single-threaded),
from the `stockfish` npm package version 17.1.0. They are distributed unmodified under the GNU GPL v3
(see `Copying.txt`).

Source code: https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js (tag for 17.1) and https://github.com/official-stockfish/Stockfish
